It is started the day after completion of chemotherapy and given until the expected neutrophil nadir is passed and the neutrophil count has recovered to the normal range, so that leucapheresis can be performed. When used alone, a lenograstim dose of 10 micrograms/kg (1.28 million international units/kg) daily is given sub- cutaneously for 4 to 6 days, with leucapheresis usually performed between days 5 and 7. For mobilisation of cells in healthy donors, to use in allogeneic transplan- tation, a dose of 10 micrograms/kg daily may be given subcutaneously for 5 or 6 days before leucapheresis. ◊ References. 1.
